goal: Evaluate one real Codex-assisted CGKN Provider-mainline project generation with the user's compatible API provider, minimize external-model usage, and create a usable integration branch only if the generated product and formal delivery evidence are good.
acceptance_criteria: Run one representative, explicit, standard-library Python CLI product request through the existing reviewed Provider route without introducing another generation or delivery path.
Do not persist or report the supplied API credential, and stop further Provider spend when the request count is clearly disproportionate to the product scope.
Treat only a formally packaged, delivery-allowed candidate with working CRUD, filtering, atomic storage, import/export, documentation, and substantive tests as good enough for a usable branch.
Do not create the conditional branch when the candidate or formal delivery evidence is incomplete or materially misses the requested product behavior.

quality_metrics.target: Provider validation, post-build finalization, local_packager, public_delivery_gate, and delivery_manifest remain the only public mainline
quality_metrics.method: kernel and formal-provider regression tests plus run-artifact inspection

quality_metrics.target: all named commands and task/bug behaviors are implemented and executable with no placeholder dispatch
quality_metrics.method: checkpoint source inspection followed by generated-project tests and CLI probes when an executable candidate exists

quality_metrics.target: component planning and repair remain proportional to a medium CLI application
quality_metrics.method: provider_phase_log request count and aggregate prompt-character inspection

prevention: Use EXP-CGKN-LIBRARIAN-001 to keep diagnostic and Provider contexts bounded.
Use EXP-CGKN-QUALITY-001 to keep generation progress, implementation quality, packaging, and delivery truth separate.
Require an explicit branch decision gate after product and formal-evidence review.
assurance: Run the relevant kernel, complexity, planning, fallback, and post-build baseline tests.
Reproduce the pre-Provider null-list crash without network access and add a focused normalization regression.
control: Run the representative request through the real compatible Provider endpoint with the cheap API-only profile.
Count Provider requests and prompt characters from the run log, then stop the run once test-component retries become disproportionate.
Inspect the generated split-file checkpoints and canonical public project directory without editing generated source.
improvement: Before another paid evaluation, add a bounded manifest/request budget and a goal-fidelity check that rejects generic orchestration skeletons for explicit CRUD products.

interface_expectations: Codex may supply a compact goal packet and review results, but CGKN must continue using whiteboard and agent_session shared communication and the reviewed Provider generation route.
A future interface must expose compact status and evidence summaries rather than replaying full component logs.
local_packager remains the only delivery exit, and a stopped or incomplete run cannot be labeled usable.

feedback: The initial real run found an explicit-null list normalization defect in component checkpoint identity; the focused fix and regression reached the Provider boundary successfully.

The resumed formal run made 87 Provider requests carrying 3,036,760 aggregate prompt characters; 70 requests and 2,643,437 prompt characters were attributed to the tests component before the run was stopped to limit further spend.

The public project contains only non-deliverable support files, and inspected Backend checkpoints expose command names without implementing task/Bug CRUD; CLI dispatch supplies strings where callable stages are required.
No generated-project pytest or CLI acceptance run was possible because no assembled executable candidate or allowed delivery was produced. The quality condition for creating a branch was not met.

worked: The formal route failed closed and preserved its incomplete evidence instead of presenting a partial project as delivered.
A no-network sentinel isolated the null-list crash before additional Provider use.
did_not_work: A medium CLI request expanded into an overcomplete 19-file test manifest and repeated generation attempts.
Generated code favored a generic import/export orchestration skeleton over the explicit domain commands and persistence behavior.
experiments: Implement and locally verify per-project manifest-size and Provider-request budgets plus deterministic goal-behavior coverage before spending another API call.
